predictions.articleTitle: China vs Bahrain Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Home Attack Break New Tactical Setup? — Scoreline Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Back China to avoid defeat in a low-scoring friendly led by a narrow 1:0 home win with 1:1 draw protection.
possibilityAssessment: China capitalize on home continuity and Zhang Yuning's form against a clean-sheet-less Bahrain side (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Under 2.5 total goals holds firm around 2.25 combined lambda and cautious friendly pacing (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
A 1:1 draw emerges if second-half friendly rotation loosens China's backline for Abdulla Yusuf Helal or Mohammed Marhoon (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: China hosts Bahrain in Guangzhou as two tight units chase friendly momentum.

spf.comment: Covers a narrow 1:0 home breakthrough and a 1:1 stalemate, as friendly rotation and China's home scoring inconsistency make an outright single call overly exposed.

over_under.comment: Supported by a 2.25 combined goal lambda (60.9% Poisson density under 2.5), Al Rumaihi's absence, and both recent 1:0 competitive meetings.

score.comment: Mirrors the two highest-density Home Win / Draw Poisson cells and reflects China's narrow home edge balanced against Bahrain's counter threat.

goals.comment: Targets the top two Poisson goal-count bands (26.7% and 23.7%) consistent with a tight friendly decided by zero to one margin.

bqc.comment: Follows China's 50% home half-time draw rate and 60% second-half home goal share, splitting between a late host winner and a full-time stalemate.
